title: Compact dashboard: tiered CTA alignment + in-line stakeholder annotations handoff
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Add a lightweight annotation layer to compact dashboard tiles that surfaces stakeholder notes and rollout CTAs without increasing visual density. Goals: 1) let product and SRE attach quick contextual notes (eg. rollout rationale, current gate status, known anomalies) directly to the tile; 2) provide a tiered CTA system (Primary: Open rollout, Secondary: View incident logs, Tertiary: Flag for follow-up) that adapts to density mode; 3) ensure keyboard and screen-reader accessibility for the annotations and CTAs. This ticket covers final visual specs, interaction microstates, and handoff assets for engineering + QA.
acceptance_criteria: Annotation pill appears on hover and via keyboard focus for each tile in compact and dense layouts
Tiered CTAs collapse to an overflow menu when width < 320px and remain discoverable by keyboard
Annotations support rich text up to 280 chars and link to external artifacts (incidents, playbooks)
Screen reader announces: 'Tile name, annotation available' and reads the pill content when expanded
Design tokens provided for color, spacing, and motion; high-contrast variant included
Handoff includes redlines, component props, and QA checklist

decisions: Keep annotation content to 280 characters to maintain parity with existing dashboard microcopy limits.
Implement tiered CTAs with priority ordering: Primary (Open rollout details), Secondary (View playbook), Tertiary (View incident logs).
Use an overflow kebab menu for tertiary actions on very small tiles instead of stacking buttons.
Adopt lazy initialization for annotation components to limit initial paint cost on heavy dashboards.
Animation duration set to 200ms with ease-out curve to balance snappiness and discoverability.
open_questions: Should annotation edits be available in-console or link out to a dedicated notes workflow? (PM leaning: link out for auditability)
How should annotations be surfaced in exported PDFs and CSVs? (Report team to confirm)
Do annotations need tenant-level RBAC controls for editing? (security to advise)
Edge case: behavior when tile is part of a grouped rollout — show group-level note or per-tile note?
qa_notes: Validate keyboard navigation across compact tiles and that focus order respects visual layout.
Force 3G/CPU throttling to ensure lazy init doesn't introduce >150ms interaction jank on initial open.
Test high-contrast mode for color tokens and focus ring visibility.
Confirm screen-reader reads 'annotation' affordance before tile metrics and reads content after expansion.
